title: Expedition Journal

about.heading: Your expedition journal
about.description: This journal keeps track of the expeditions you've started. Each expedition gets its own page, and field notes are added as you explore, so you can look back on what you've discovered.
steps: Start an expedition to add its page to this journal.
Complete checkpoints to record field notes about what you learned.
Record every note to reach the summit and earn a flag on your mountain.
about.saved: Your journal is saved in this browser.
about.empty: You haven't started any expeditions yet.

lockedHint: Keep exploring this expedition to add this note.
storageUnavailable: Progress can't be saved in this browser, so it will be lost when you leave this page.
